pages.text: The nekos roaming the world come in various types, but they share many $(#FF69B4)common traits$(). Understanding these basics will help you get along with them better~

pages.title: Common Traits
pages.text: $(li)Every neko has a $(thing)Neko Energy bar$(), the source of her power$(li)Each neko has 1~3 $(thing)Moe Tags$() that determine her personality and behavior$(li)Nekos can be $(#FF69B4)tamed$() using a $(item)Contract$(), making her your companion$(li)Two nekos can $(#FF69B4)breed$(), producing a baby with mixed genes$(br2)Check later chapters for more details!

pages.title: Daily Behaviors
pages.text: Nekos display all kinds of adorable behaviors in daily life:$(br2)$(li)They $(#FF69B4)pick up items$() from the ground, especially things they like$(li)They $(#FF69B4)follow their owners$() and accompany them on adventures$(li)When injured, they $(#FF69B4)eat food to heal$() — very self-sufficient$(li)They $(#FF69B4)auto-equip$() armor and weapons they receive$(li)At night they look for nearby beds and sleep peacefully$(br2)With a neko companion, you'll never adventure alone!

pages.title: Natural Spawning
pages.text: Nekos naturally spawn in specific $(thing)biomes$(). Different types prefer different environments:$(br2)$(li)Adventurer Neko — mountains, forests, plains and other common terrain$(li)Fighting Neko — the Nether, ancient cities, mountains$(li)Ghost Neko — swamps, forests, cherry groves and other quiet places$(br2)Also, on a certain $(#FF69B4)special day$() each year, rumor has it that a mysterious neko named $(#FF69B4)Crystal_Neko$() will quietly appear somewhere in the world...
